correctness.rationale: Any length-three module has radical Hilbert function (3),(2,1) or (1,1,1); since m^3U=0 and f starts in order three, the first two strata are determined by the relation xY=yX without higher-jet restrictions. In (3) quotients give Gr(3,2d). For (2,1), independent x,y actions yield a symmetric three-row Hankel system with rank-two surjectivity; subtract the rank-deficient cone of class 1+(L+1)(L^d-1) and quotient by a special G_m⋉G_a^2 automorphism group. Proportional actions give a P1 family of rank-one pencils, with special (G_m)^2⋉G_a^3 quotient, producing (L+1)L^(2d-2)[P^(d-1)][P^(2d-2)]. For cyclic (1,1,1) modules, f3 selects exactly r projective tangent roots and one affine curvature coordinate, yielding r L^(3d-1)[P^(d-1)]. Independent class identities, d=1 specialization and F2 rank-one length-three submodule enumeration (19 for three tangents) corroborate. Only reduced constructible motives over C are asserted; whole-scheme equality is not proved.
